feature: CCNA Switching: PortFast and BPDU Guard

topology.ASW1: VLAN 10 Gi0/1 to PC1; Gi0/3 test edge to ROGUE; Gi0/24 normal VLAN 10/99 trunk to DSW1
topology.DSW1: VLAN 10 trusted root, base priority 8192; PC2 on Gi0/1
topology.ROGUE: Base priority 4096; Gi0/1 starts shut; PC3 on VLAN 10 Gi0/2

checks: practice is independent, safely staged and starts with zero earned tasks and pre-addressed clients
published setup enables immediate host-edge forwarding without making the trusted trunk an edge or guarded port
an actual superior BPDU err-disables only the rogue edge, logs once and preserves the root and legitimate traffic
BPDU Guard also shuts an edge on inferior BPDUs, not just an attempted root takeover
PortFast by itself does not block BPDUs or stop a superior rogue from becoming root
configured protection without delivered BPDUs cannot earn the incident or recovery goals
a premature manual reset trips again while the rogue still sends BPDUs
removing the source alone leaves err-disable latched; manual recovery retains protection and may correctly leave the link down
automatic recovery is disabled by default, including after the cause is removed
optional configured timer recovery is real, retrips with an active source and recovers once it is removed
completed reference actually earns the BPDU incident and recovers safely, leaving real traffic tests for the learner
published verification commands show live err-disable reasons, BPDU Guard logs, recovery defaults, edge and normal trunk state
saved reload and startup power cycles preserve incident observations while live configuration and forwarding are re-evaluated
incident and interface criteria are bounded on import and an unrelated err-disable cannot earn BPDU observation credit
scope: Adds a staged IOS switching lab, explicit BPDU Guard/err-disable lesson properties, persistent observed-incident credit and BPDU Guard diagnostic logs/events on real err-disable transitions. Uses the existing received-BPDU STP and packet-forwarding engines. The completed reference executes the actual setup, trip and recovery commands; no fabricated incident or traffic credit is inserted. No backend, dependencies or live CML validation is claimed.
